authority: Reconciles Issue #72 research against the existing P2P capability foundation. Extends capabilities.json and reuses the single existing router. Never creates a second router/registry/orchestrator. No video model, framework, weight, paid API, credential, or infrastructure is introduced.

research_reference.short_scope: research evidence only; production-spec structure (identity, scene, performance, camera, physics, timeline, audio, speech, continuity, negative constraints) informs the director spec, performance bible, and continuity gate fields.

research_sources.rationale: Director-first cinematic prompt framework for Seedance 2.5 (Jimeng). Overlaps the provider-neutral director spec concept. Extract the production-spec structure as knowledge evidence; do NOT vendor the provider-specific prompt framework as an executable capability.
Curated Seedance prompt library. Provider-specific prompt-shape evidence only. Do not vendor or install; confirm the projection pattern of short provider prompts.

Open-source video generation model. For this task it is a research reference only; non-goal explicitly forbids installing Wan2.2. Reinforces the lesson that a model cannot be relied on for identity across shots.

Reference-aware video editing / consistency editing framework. Overlaps canonical visual consistency. Confirms consistency should be canonical and exterior to the renderer; not adopted as a runtime dependency.
Camera/motion re-control for video. Overlaps the performance-bible camera feel/inertia cues. Knowledge reference; no runtime adoption.
Curated character-consistency method list. Overlaps the canonical visual / continuity dimensions; used as a reference index only.

Script/material/narration/subtitle/music/render auto-video pipeline. For this task extract only architecture lessons (staged pipeline, agent execution contract, credential hygiene, paid-generation Owner Gate, bounded retry/recovery, final artifact return). DEFER install/vendor; no video generation runtime is added here.

conceptual_overlap.rationale: No provider-neutral video director/production specification exists in capabilities.json or the capability catalogs.

The 3D asset forge character recipe/visual pack overlap canonical visual identity, but are MPFB2/3D-specific and do not model shot-to-shot or temporal video consistency. Reuse the asset-pointer convention; do not co-opt the MPFB2 schema.
Both carry motion/camera-feel vocabulary but are Three.js/UI-runtime knowledge, not a provider-neutral video performance bible. Adjacent, not equivalent.
